label: sec:archimedean-lifting-topological-mass-variants-preamble
html: Building upon the topological-mass theorem and its conjectural extension, this sub-section unfolds the associated family of variants—eigenspace decomposition, holonomy, transient localisation, and quantum dilogarithm—providing an independent proof for each. The \mathrm{SU}(2) instance anchors this family, supplying the input for the downstream mechanics.
